question: Who is known as the 'Father of Modern Indian Art' and is famous for works like Shakuntala, Rang Rasiya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Ravi Verma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raja Ravi Verma** is widely recognized as the **'Father of Modern Indian Art'** for his groundbreaking contributions to Indian painting.
 
• He was a celebrated 19th-century artist, renowned for his exceptional ability to blend **Indian traditions** with **European techniques** in his artwork.
 
• His most famous works include **‘Shakuntala’**, which depicts the protagonist from Kalidasa’s play, and **‘Rang Rasiya’**, which beautifully portrays mythological and historical themes.
 
• Ravi Verma is acclaimed for his **realistic portrayal of Indian women**, especially from mythological epics like the **Ramayana** and the **Mahabharata**.
 
• He was one of the first Indian artists to use **oil painting** as a medium and successfully brought **mythological stories** to life with his vivid and detailed depictions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Abanindranath Tagore:**

 
 
• He was a prominent Indian artist and founder of the **Bengal School of Art**.
 
• His works are known for their emphasis on **Indian heritage and tradition**, rejecting Western artistic styles.
 
• Famous paintings by him include **'Bharat Mata'** and works inspired by Indian mythology.
 
 
 
• **Raja Ravi Verma:**
 
 
• Born in **1848** in Kilimanoor, Kerala, he is considered a pioneer in **modern Indian art**.
 
• He successfully popularized **Indian mythology** by printing his paintings, making them accessible to common people.
 
• His famous paintings include **'Hamsa Damayanti'**, **'Shakuntala Patralekhan'**, and **'Jatayu Vadha'**.
 
 
 
• **Nandalal Bose:**
 
 
• A key figure in modern Indian art, he was known for his association with the **Indian Independence Movement**.
 
• He illustrated the **original manuscript of the Constitution of India** and was inspired by the Ajanta cave paintings.
 
 
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore:**
 
 
• Primarily known as a Nobel Laureate in Literature, Tagore was also a **painter**.
 
• His paintings exhibited **abstract and symbolic forms**, with a unique style that did not conform to traditional norms.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Artistic Contributions of Raja Ravi Verma:**

 
 
• He was a pioneer in the **fusion of Indian and European art styles**, setting a benchmark in Indian art.
 
• His works have inspired generations of artists and filmmakers, as seen in the movie **'Rang Rasiya'**, based on his life.
 
• His use of **oil paints** and attention to detail brought Indian stories to life on canvas.
 
 
 
• **Legacy:**
 
 
• Raja Ravi Verma’s printed lithographs made Indian mythology accessible to the masses and helped preserve cultural stories.
 
• He was awarded the **Kaiser-i-Hind Gold Medal** in 1904 by the British Government for his contributions to art.
